origin: the closing ceremony was entered only on the user's signal or a convergence read, and a triage fold that re-settles the map had no path into it: this walk holds a user who never signals conclusion and pins that a drain whose fold re-decides the last open ground — its discussion-map set answering all_decided — opens the closing gates in the same turn as the absorb, with no prose question in between
conduct: The user settled how card payments at checkout should work and concluded the discussion in earlier sittings; the specification pass sent one question back — the retry decision never weighed the gateway's soft/hard decline split — and they have come to settle it. Picking the session up they take what is offered: shown the parked concern they want it discussed now. When it is put to them they accept the challenge on the merits rather than defending the earlier decision, and land it decisively: retries apply to soft declines only — three attempts with exponential backoff, as before — and a hard decline ends the attempt at once, no retry, with the order left open so the shopper can use another card; because re-presenting a hard decline gains nothing and risks the merchant account, and the gateway reports the decline class on every failure so the split costs nothing. They engage concretely, answer with reasons, and decide rather than park. Beyond resolving that concern they volunteer nothing. They never say the discussion covers it, never ask to wrap up, finish, or conclude, and never ask what comes next. They answer what a rendered menu or a direct question asks and nothing more; a question put to them in prose once the retry decision has landed — anything else, shall we wrap up, where next — gets one flat sentence that they have nothing to add, and never more than that. On rendered gates they are agreeable: offered one more review they decline it; told a review must run before concluding they agree; asked on the rendered conclude menu whether to conclude they say yes. They never introduce new material.
